The `SKILL.md` instructions guide the AI agent on how to use the script with user-provided locations. There is no evidence of intentional harmful behavior, data exfiltration beyond the API key to the legitimate service, persistence mechanisms, or malicious prompt injection attempts against the agent. The skill's behavior is clearly aligned with its stated purpose and lacks meaningful high-risk behaviors or vulnerabilities within its own code.
